description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
